body: Merger rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-23 02:34Z), learned from w-ac230 gate test-70ced701. Merger had accepted the w-ac230 claim and launched the detached full gate in .tmp/wt-ac230-11466 in the same turn. The host was still measuring that turn in w-33f4's root (.tmp/wt-eval-token-11465), so it refused the run credit. A gate bound to a test criterion only counts when the host recorded the check, so the run became diagnostic only. Rule: before EVERY gate, Merger names the gate worktree for that item's claim with termal_name_source_root, with focus on the item. Naming takes effect next turn, so Merger launches the gate in the FOLLOWING turn. If a gate runs without credit, let it finish as diagnostic (never kill it), then run one credited gate on the identical tree and record it as a credit repair.
